title: 房间温度模型对应的物理对象
caption: 在环境温度固定的近似中，x_t 是房间相对环境的温差，u_t 是给定的加热输入，传感器在时刻 t 读取 y_t=x_t。状态随后按 x_{t+1}=0.8x_t+u_t 形成下一时刻温差。图中没有控制器；系数 0.8 表示该离散模型中未加热时保留下来的温差比例。
brief: Scientific illustration: a simple physical room with heating device, a separate temperature sensor, and outdoor ambient environment. The model input is GIVEN EXOGENOUS HEATING, not feedback control. Draw a flat two-dimensional architectural room cross-section with simple heater/radiator, a wall temperature sensor, heat entering room from heater and heat leaving room through the outer wall to cooler ambient. No thermostat, no controller, no temperature setpoint, no sensor line back to the heater, no solar heating, no fan or ventilation network. Indoor model state is temperature difference relative to the constant ambient; the sensor measures that present state without noise. The scalar state update is next-state=0.8×current-state+given-heating; these will be real-font text added later, no numeric marks now. A single sensor measurement arrow exits to a small blank readout area. Heating input arrow clearly comes from outside into heater. Outward heat-loss arrow should pass through wall toward ambient, visually distinct from sensor signal. Use restrained orange heating, pale blue ambient, sparse sage room region or mostly white interiors, green measurement. Actual physical illustration rich enough to connect equations to objects, not merely a row of generic rectangles. Reserve label gaps next to heater, room state, sensor reading and ambient; do not add blank caption cards for every object. Leave a clean white margin below the illustration for the scalar formula and timing note. External references contain thermostat/circuits that are NOT part of our simplified target.
